title: JBS Australia Celebrates Brand Week at its Scone Facility

body_markdown:
Last week, JBS Southern celebrated Brand Week at its Scone facility in New South Wales, giving the team the opportunity to learn more about the premium brands and products they help make every day. Held over three days, Brand Week is designed to connect employees with the brands they contribute to, showcase the unique programs behind our products, and highlight the journey of Scone-produced beef to customers around the world.


The week featured a brand showcase in the chillers, where Harriet Brawne, Brand Marketing Manager for Southern, took employees from all areas of the plant through JBS Southern's brand portfolio. Harriet shared insights into the Farm Assurance program, highlighted the premium product range, and explained the quality standards and claims that differentiate the Farm Assurance brands in global markets.


Building on this, Aimee Bolton and Scone grader Kyrone Brennan delivered an MSA grading demonstration, giving an insight into the grading process and how each carcase is segregated into each brand. The Scone team also had the chance to experience innovation in action during lunchtime interactive sessions hosted by the Innovation team. Featuring VR headsets and the JT avatar, the sessions generated plenty of excitement and gave employees a different perspective on the future of technology within the business.


Another highlight of the week was a presentation from Rob Ryan, Head of Beef Sales, who shared insights into his role and provided an overview of where Scone products are sent across the globe. His presentation helped bring the supply chain to life, connecting the work done at Scone with customers in international markets. To conclude the week, there was a site-wide BBQ and take-home gift for all employees with Scone branded merch and premium cuts of Pinnacle and Red Gum steaks. This gave everyone the opportunity to take home and try out the branded products for themselves.
